items.quote: And Abimelech said unto Abraham, What sawest thou, that thou hast done this thing?
items.claim: Abimelech asked Abraham what he saw that prompted his action

items.quote: And Abraham said, Because I thought, Surely the fear of God is not in this place; and they will slay me for my wife's sake.
items.claim: Abraham stated he feared being killed because he believed God was not feared in that place
